arxiv-2104-07356.title: Constraints on Cosmographic Functions of Cosmic Chronometers Data Using Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2104-07356.creator: A. M. Velasquez-Toribio, Júlio C. Fabris
arxiv-2104-07356.description: Abstract Resumo We study observational constraints on the cosmographic functions up to the fourth derivative of the scale factor with respect to cosmic time, i.e., the so-called snap function, using the non-parametric method of Gaussian Processes. As observational data we use the Hubble parameter data.

arxiv-2105-00204.title: Credibility in Second-Price Auctions: An Experimental Test
arxiv-2105-00204.creator: Ahrash Dianat, Mikhail Freer
arxiv-2105-00204.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ahrash Dianat, Mikhail Freer. We provide the first direct test of how the credibility of an auction format affects bidding behavior and final outcomes. To do so, we conduct a series of laboratory experiments where the role of the seller is played by a human subject who receives the revenue from the auction and who (depending on the treatment) has agency to determine the outcome of the auction.

Half-Heusler (HH) alloys, which are potential thermoelectric materials have demonstrated significant improvements in thermoelectric performance owing to their thermal stability, mechanical strength, and moderate ZT. arxiv-2503-13651.title: Quantized Magneto-Terahertz Effects in the Antiferromagnetic Topological Insulator MnBi 2 Te 4 Thin Films
arxiv-2503-13651.creator: Xingyue Han, An-Hsi Chen, Matthew Brahlek, Liang Wu
arxiv-2503-13651.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xingyue Han, An-Hsi Chen, Matthew Brahlek, Liang Wu. MnBi 2 Te 4 (MBT) is an ideal platform for studying the interplay between magnetism and topology. Many exotic topological phenomena, such as the quantum anomalous Hall effect and the axion insulator, have been observed in few-layer MBT. A key feature in MBT is the emergence of the surface exchange gap, which lies in the milli-electron-volt range (1 THz corresponds to 4.14 meV). This makes THz spectroscopy a powerful tool to probe the associated topological physics.

arxiv-2507-16353.title: A Semi-analytic but Biased Uncertainty Assessment Method using Sample Extensions, Analysed for Nonlinear Travel Time Tomography
arxiv-2507-16353.creator: Xuebin Zhao, Andrew Curtis
arxiv-2507-16353.description: Abstract Many geophysical problems can be cast as inverse problems that estimate a set of parameter values from observed data. Within a Bayesian framework, solutions to such problems are described probabilistically by the so-called posterior probability distribution functions (pdf’s) which combines a priori information with information from measured data.

arxiv-2507-20899.title: Fairness under Equal-Sized Bundles: Impossibility Results and Approximation Guarantees
arxiv-2507-20899.creator: Alviona Mancho, Evangelos Markakis, Nicos Protopapas
arxiv-2507-20899.description: Abstract We study the fair allocation of indivisible goods under cardinality constraints, where each agent must receive a bundle of fixed size. This models practical scenarios–such as assigning shifts or forming equally sized teams. Recently, variants of envy-freeness up to one/any item (EF1, EFX) were introduced for this setting, based on flips or exchanges of items.

pmc-11348406.title: Severe hypokalemia mimicking classical electrocardiographic pattern of left Main coronary artery disease: A case report and a focused review of the literature
pmc-11348406.creator: Vásquez Lozano Sergio Humberto, Porras Bueno Cristian Orlando, Ruiz Hernández Gabriel Fernando, Olarte Jurado Mabel Lucero, Maria Paula Blanco Rueda
pmc-11348406.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Key Clinical MessageSeveral electrocardiographic alterations due to hypokalemia have been described, but the electrocardiographic presentation meeting criteria for occlusion of the left main coronary artery is very rare. We describe a case of hypokalemia simulating it. INTRODUCTION

An obstructive lesion of the left main coronary artery (LMCA) has typically been described on the electrocardiogram (ECG) as a generalized ST segment depression (STD) (maximum in V4–V6) associated with inverted T waves in the same leads, and ST segment elevation (STE) in aVR.

pmc-12460367.creator: Sanne ten Berg, Margriet Bogerd, Elma J. Peters, Marijke J. C. Timmermans, Wim K. Lagrand, Luuk C. Otterspoor, Alexander P. J. Vlaar, Annemarie E. Engström, José P. S. pmc-12460367.description: BackgroundVasopressors and inotropes remain the cornerstone in treatment of acute myocardial infarction-related cardiogenic shock (AMI-CS). Milrinone and dobutamine are both commonly used, yet the optimal inotrope remains unclear. We aimed to identify factors associated with milrinone and dobutamine treatment and assess their effects on 30-day mortality in a large real-world cohort of AMI-CS patients.

pmc-12468770.title: Mechanistic Insights into Proglumide’s Role in Immune Cell Efficacy and Response to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-12468770.creator: Priyanka S. Doneparthi, Hong Cao, Wenqiang Chen, Wenyu Dou, Hong-Bin Fang, Jill. P. Smith
pmc-12468770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the fastest-growing cause of cancer-related death worldwide. Treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) has shown promise in HCC; however, the response rate remains less than 50%. One reason for the low efficacy is fibrosis in most livers that harbor HCC and in the tumor which prevents the penetration of anti-cancer agents and influx of CD8+ T-cells.

pmc-12542269.title: Civilian mass exposure to hydrazine after an F-16 crash: a retrospective descriptive study
pmc-12542269.creator: Asli Bahar Ucar, Hasan Demir, Haldun Akoglu
pmc-12542269.description: BackgroundHydrazine is a volatile and highly toxic monopropellant used in the Emergency Power Unit (EPU) of F-16 aircraft. Although hydrazine is widely used in both military and industrial contexts, reports of its effects in non-occupational civilian populations are extremely limited. Acute civilian mass exposures are almost never systematically documented.

pmc-13400742.title: Symmetry-driven gating of TRPM8 by PIP2 and menthol
pmc-13400742.creator: Sun-Hong Kim, Chansik Hong, Hyunwoo Park, Youngchang Ju, Youngsoo Hwang, Jinhyeong Kim, Sangho Ji, Wookyung Yu, Insuk So, Hyung Ho Lee
pmc-13400742.description: TRPM8, a cold-activated ion channel, enables mammals to sense cooling agents such as menthol. While PIP2 is essential for menthol-induced activation of TRPM8, the precise cooperative mechanism and the specific binding mode of menthol have remained elusive. Here, we present cryo-EM structures of mouse TRPM8 in diverse conformations, including a PIP2-induced two-fold symmetric intermediate and an icilin-bound open state.

pmc-13413764.title: Evaluating the Diagnostic Value of Clinical and Laboratory Parameters in Older Adults with Abdominal Pain: A Retrospective Analysis of CT Predictors
pmc-13413764.creator: Deniz Akyar, Nurseli Bayram, Ozge Ecmel Onur, Haldun Akoglu, Arzu Denizbasi
pmc-13413764.description: Background and Objectives: This study aims to evaluate easily accessible clinical and laboratory parameters in older adults presenting with nontraumatic abdominal pain and to explore factors associated with significant findings on abdominal computed tomography (CT). The goal is to help prevent diagnostic delays and reduce emergency department (ED) length of stay by minimizing unnecessary testing.

pmc-13504280.title: Gendered patterns of common mental health outcomes and suicidal ideation after suicide bereavement and the role of perceived social support
pmc-13504280.creator: Eve Griffin, Grace Cully, Sophie Veronneau, Fiona Tuomey, Selena O’Connell, Karl Andriessen
pmc-13504280.description: Each year ∼10 million people globally are bereaved by suicide. Data from a national Irish survey of adults bereaved or affected by suicide were used. In total, 2413 participants completed the survey.
